purpose: Canonical ownership and data-flow map for the Bordeaux C-UAS demonstration.

bod_cuas.role: airport scenario, synthetic replay, provider fixtures, LFBD demo profile and policy fixtures
must_not_own: generic coverage equations or geometry types

furia_core.role: authoritative operational contracts, policy, generic computation and provider boundary
owns: normalized operational events and authority state
must_not_own: LFBD-specific demo constants in generic crates

furia_cuas.role: generic C-UAS domain services, SAPIENT adapters and deterministic simulation

furia_ui.role: reusable UI primitives, contracts and 2D/3D operational visualisation
must_not_own: LFBD default data as the only supported world
transitional: LFBDTrainingWorld3D, LFBDBati3DViewer and DEFAULT_LFBD_COVERAGE_PROFILE remain compatibility exports; new hosts should use OperationalWorld3D, OperationalCoverage3DViewer and an injected AirportCoverageProfile

furia_c2.role: deployable host, composition, transport adapters and runtime wiring
must_not_own: canonical LFBD geometry or replay fixtures
transitional: embedded LFBD constants in Console.tsx are compatibility code and must migrate behind an airport-profile adapter

bordeaux_cuas_planning.role: geospatial planning and screening research workspace
owns: planning optimisation outputs and audit reports
bordeaux_cuas_planning.export_boundary: Only validated, versioned, provenance-bearing derived exports are consumed by BOD-CUAS or furia-c2. Raw source archives and multi-gigabyte working files stay in this repository.

bordeaux_airport_staging.reason: Contains a large untracked OBJ copy and is not a versioned source of truth. Keep until hashes and provenance are reconciled with the planning repository.

data_flow: bod_cuas airport profile -> furia_c2 airport adapter -> generic furia_ui map/3D primitives
bordeaux_cuas_planning -> validated geospatial export -> bod_cuas airport profile
bod_cuas synthetic scenario -> furia_core provider boundary -> furia_c2 operational stream
furia_c2 normalized projection -> furia_ui parameterised workspace
furia_core policy and safety state -> furia_c2 constrained actions -> furia_ui operator feedback
migration_rules: Do not copy generic coverage models into BOD-CUAS or furia-ui.
Do not copy raw meshes, DEMs or imagery into runtime repositories.
Every planning export must identify source data, coordinate reference, model version, timestamp and screening status.
Airport-specific defaults belong in an airport profile or scenario adapter, never in a generic primitive.
No repository is allowed to imply live ATC, aviation authority or effect authority for synthetic data.
